headline: SecMark Consultancy submits scrutineer report and e-voting results for 15th AGM
summary: SecMark Consultancy has submitted the scrutinizer's report and e-voting results following its 15th Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing complies with standard regulatory disclosure requirements for listed entities. Retail investors can review the passed resolutions in the official exchange filing. The update carries no immediate financial or operational impact for shareholders.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on share price or business fundamentals.

headline: Secmark completes its 15th Annual General Meeting
hook: Routine business cleared by Secmark shareholders
summary: Secmark held its 15th Annual General Meeting on Wednesday, September 30, 2026. Shareholders discussed and voted on the listed agenda items. This standard regulatory compliance filing is required for all publicly listed companies. Indian retail investors tracking the company note routine administrative progress.
why_it_matters: Standard procedural update with no immediate financial impact
